title: Why IndiGo loses ₹1,879 cr despite 34% yield jump

outro.text: Will the December 1 fuel price push fares higher? IndiGo's yield jumped 34 percent. It still lost 1,879 crore.

sources: IndiGo Q2 FY27 press release (BSE, Oct. 29, 2026)
IndiGo Q2 FY27 earnings call (AlphaStreet transcript)

scenes.text: IndiGo's yield jumped 34 percent. It still lost 1,879 crore.
That is its third losing quarter in a row. So where did the money go?

card.title: Fuel cost per passenger
card.source: IndiGo Q2 FY27 press release (fuel cost ÷ passengers)

scenes.text: Our calculation: each passenger burned ₹3,624 of fuel, up 75 percent.
Six of every ten rupees lost came from the rupee, not the flying.
Delhi to Mumbai now earns ₹7,180, up 34 percent per kilometre.
Cost per passenger hit ₹9,520. After every bit of income, IndiGo still loses ₹680 on each flyer.

funnel.long_title: Your IndiGo ticket costs more. So why is IndiGo still losing money?
